content: निर्वाहः .²1 Carrying on, accomplishing, performing. .²2 Completion, end. .²3 Carrying to the end, supporting, steadfast adherence, perseverance; निर्वाहः प्रतिपन्नवस्तुषु सतामेतद्धि गोत्रव्रतम् <ls>Mu. 2. 18</ls>. .²4 Subsisting on. .²5 Sufficiency, competent provision, competency. .²6 Describing, narrating.
